title: BPS Recommended Plan Type Vocabulary
description: Non-normative recommended values for the `plan_type` field. These are the U.S.-standard plan-design classifications. Adopters MAY use additional values when needed.

plan_types.label: HMO
plan_types.description: Health Maintenance Organization. Closed network; typically requires PCP referrals.

plan_types.label: PPO
plan_types.description: Preferred Provider Organization. In- and out-of-network coverage with different cost shares.

plan_types.label: EPO
plan_types.description: Exclusive Provider Organization. Closed network without referrals.

plan_types.label: Medicare Advantage with Part D
plan_types.description: MA plan with integrated prescription drug coverage.

plan_types.label: Special Needs Plan
plan_types.description: Medicare Special Needs Plan (D-SNP, I-SNP, C-SNP).
